_comment: Areas Lore of Azeroth leaves out of a zone, so that each place is listed once, where the
game puts it. Each was listed under a zone that neither client's AreaTable puts it in:
a city or zone of its own copied into the zone around it (Stormwind City in Elwynn Forest),
or an area copied into a neighbour (Ruins of Alterac in Hillsbrad Foothills). The evidence
is each name's AreaTable rows (ID, and the area it sits in) in Era 1.15.9.69109 and
Forever 1.60.1.69913, from wago.tools. A place the client has in two zones (Southfury
River, Thandol Span) stays in both. lore/export.mjs leaves these rows out.
`kept` are the exceptions: passages that join two places (a tunnel, a city's gate) stay
at both ends, though the client files them under one.
